name: Wolves in the Throne Room
label: Southern Lord
lede: Two brothers on an Olympia farm turned black metal into a firelit ritual of place, and never bought the rock and roll machine.

eras.title: A cabin on Calliope Farm
eras.text: Two brothers move to an abandoned farm outside Olympia, Washington and start playing black metal in a decaying cabin. The rules are set early: the land comes first, and the band comes second.

years.cap: Two Hunters photo shoot. By Carli Davidson · Wikimedia
years.h: Two brothers, one cabin, and Olympia's woods
years.p: [[Nathan Weaver|497bb953-3e90-423a-a60f-67b39cfc8cc8]] and [[Aaron Weaver|18cd9eb0-f3f9-4e81-95fa-003e0c089c96]] form Wolves in the Throne Room in Olympia, holding their first practice in a rundown cabin on Calliope Farm.
years.xp:
The brothers had recently moved to the abandoned farm outside Olympia. Aaron later described the band's aim as uncovering the spiritual and energetic reality of a place, which is why they treat the Pacific Northwest landscape as the point rather than the backdrop.

They favored crust, doom and Norwegian and American black metal, and rejected corpse paint, pseudonyms and Satanic imagery from the start.

years.h: A black CD-R wrapped in fur, with moss in the sleeve
years.p: The self-released 2004 demo goes out as a black CD-R wrapped in fur, with moss tucked into the lyric sheet.
years.xp: Guitarist Nick Paul, met through the local scene and a fan of Death, Bolt Thrower and Swans, played on the first demo and left shortly after it was recorded.

years.h: Nick Paul leaves after the first demo
years.p: Guitarist Nick Paul, who had joined around 2003, departs soon after recording the band's 2004 demo.

eras.title: Eleven hundred dollars and a pregnant guest
eras.text: Rick Dahlin joins, the band plays its way to San Francisco, and a debut gets made for almost nothing. It is enough to get the attention of Southern Lord.

years.p: [[Rick Dahlin|92730c72-0b59-4721-a85f-a097c7214eef]] joins in early 2005, and the trio starts on a second demo that includes two songs later heard on the debut album.
Recorded by Tim Green at Louder Studios in San Francisco on a budget of about $1,100, and released by Vendlus Records.
years.xp:
The band played San Francisco shows to raise the money and borrowed gear from local band Ludicra. Jamie Myers of Hammers of Misfortune sang on it while nine months pregnant.

Pitchfork wrote that the folk and goth touches are what separate them from the pack.

years.h: Southern Lord picks up the band
years.p: After Diadem of 12 Stars, Southern Lord signs Wolves in the Throne Room and later reissues the debut on vinyl.

eras.title: The Southern Lord years
eras.text: Three records in three years turn a farm band into the flagship of American black metal. Synths, a producer who understands tape and a growing live show do the work.

years.p: First album with producer [[Randall Dunn|f2be6d74-fac1-4199-9ddc-f3f280630994]], built on analog synths like the Korg Polysix and Minimoog.
years.xp:
Persian classical vocalist [[Jessika Kenney|d7e40021-e86e-4f64-85d5-6c36770fd2f3]] sings on "Cleansing" and "I Will Lay Down My Bones Among the Rocks and Roots." The vinyl carries a much longer "Cleansing" and the extra track "To Reveal."

Pitchfork gave it 7.9. Wikipedia says it put the band at the front of North American black metal.

years.p: Guitarist Rick Dahlin's tenure ends around 2007; Wikipedia dates it 2005 to 2007.

years.cap: Wolves in the Throne Room, Tivoli Helling, Utrecht · Wikimedia
years.p: The band plays Roadburn in 2008 and again in 2009. The festival later issues Live at Roadburn 2008.
years.xp: The band insists on firelit shows, outdoors or in, and bans flash photography. Guitarist and bassist [[Will Lindsay|e6f0e493-c32c-4f60-a204-33079b520b15]] joins for 2008 to 2009. They also play Hellfest, Graspop and Roskilde.

years.h: Will Lindsay joins on guitar and bass
years.p: Will Lindsay becomes the band's third member for the touring years around Black Cascade.
Four tracks in about 50 minutes, with the opener named for Caspar David Friedrich's painting Wanderer above the Sea of Fog.
years.xp: Aaron Weaver told The Obelisk it was a live-first record, unlike the studio-built Two Hunters, and that recording onto tape with Randall Dunn made everything harder. Reviews split: PopMatters gave it 8/10, Pitchfork 4.5.

years.big: Touring is a phase, not a life
years.h: Aaron Weaver on the rock and roll machine
years.p: On the Black Cascade tour cycle, Aaron said the band would find another way and not get caught up in the machine.
years.xp: The band toured the US and Europe with Sunn O))), Earth and Weedeater. Aaron also told The Obelisk he was uneasy about corporate festival sponsorship, naming Scion's marketing as the part he found most unnerving.

years.h: Malevolent Grain EP on Southern Lord
years.p: A Southern Lord EP arrives in 2009, with Jamie Myers back on vocals.
Lindsay's time as third member ends in 2009, leaving the two brothers.

eras.title: Two brothers and a fire
eras.text: Down to the Weaver brothers, the band writes its most complete album and gets picked by one of its heroes.

years.h: Godspeed You! Black Emperor pick them for ATP
years.p: Godspeed You! Black Emperor curate the All Tomorrow's Parties festival in Minehead, England, and choose Wolves in the Throne Room.
The first album written and recorded without a third guitarist, again with Randall Dunn and with vocals from Jessika Kenney.
years.xp: Brandon Stosuy of Pitchfork called it American black metal's defining record of 2011. AllMusic's Eduardo Rivadavia found it their most refined and confident outing.

years.h: The Bell House, Brooklyn, the night before release day
years.p: A show at the Bell House in Brooklyn on September 12, 2011 is later released as Live at the Bell House 9.12.11 (2015).
Southern Lord releases a live BBC session recorded in 2011.

eras.title: Their own label
eras.text: The brothers run Artemisia Records, build a studio in the woods and follow a dark ambient detour with the record they say they had to make.

years.p: Released on the band's own Artemisia Records as a companion to Celestial Lineage, with no metal on it.
years.xp: The Quietus said the band can "handhold a listener through incredibly dense forest in very low light."

years.p: The debut is remastered and reissued in June 2016, with a North American tour.
Back to black metal on Artemisia, with Norse myth in it and a third guitarist, Kody Keyworth.
years.xp: Aaron said the music was ready to flow out. They built a studio in the Olympia woods and started Artemisia so they would not have to travel to a city to record.

years.p: Guitarist and vocalist Kody Keyworth is in the band from 2017 and stays.

years.h: Metal Hammer names them Best Underground Band
years.p: Wolves in the Throne Room win the Golden Gods award in London, then tour with Enslaved on the Decibel tour and with Behemoth and At the Gates.

eras.title: A bigger label
eras.text: Century Media, then Relapse, a bass player and a European run with Dimmu Borgir. The farm and the fire stay.

years.p: Bassist and vocalist [[Galen Baudhuin|f5edde0f-6623-4d29-a36e-f32cdc727542]] becomes a member, playing on Primordial Arcana.
The band signs to Century Media Records.

years.h: Touring Europe with Dimmu Borgir and Amorphis
years.p: The band supports Dimmu Borgir and Amorphis on a European tour.
Previewed by the single "Mountain Magick" on June 10.
An EP follows on Relapse, led by the single "Twin Mouthed Spring" on September 29.
